# semaphore_ex_project_terraform_backend_alias (Data Source)

Manage an alias and Basic-auth credential binding for one encrypted Terraform HTTP backend inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_terraform_backend_alias" "state" {
  project_id   = 1
  inventory_id = 2
  id           = "opaque-alias-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque alias identifier assigned by Semaphore EX.
- `inventory_id` (Number) Terraform, OpenTofu, or Terragrunt workspace inventory. Value must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) Project containing the Terraform workspace. Value must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `auth_key_id` (Number) Project login-password key used as the HTTP backend Basic-auth credential.
- `url` (String) HTTP backend address for this alias. Configure it as TF_HTTP_ADDRESS, TF_HTTP_LOCK_ADDRESS, and TF_HTTP_UNLOCK_ADDRESS.
